Ever wondered how world and Olympic champion weightlifters train their core? This video breaks down the Milko Bench Press, a powerful abs exercise that stiffens the lumbar spine and keeps the lower back strong. We provide a four-step progression, making this advanced core workout accessible for anyone looking to build a resilient core, just like the pros!
